plugin.name: RetreatFnSucks
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: re/rw/rn/rs/ru/rd retreat in one direction and keep retrying it on every failure

muclient.script:
-- ===================================================================== -- Colours (user's standard theme) -- x099 brackets / x045 name / W message / x048 highlight -- ===================================================================== local CLR_TAG = "#875FFF" -- x099 local CLR_NAME = "#00D7FF" -- x045 local CLR_MSG = "#FFFFFF" -- W local CLR_HI = "#00FF87" -- x048
local TAG = "RetreatFnSucks"
local function echo (msg) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", msg) end
-- [RetreatFnSucks] <msg><HI hi><tail> local function echoHi (msg, hi, tail) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", msg, CLR_HI, "", hi, CLR_MSG, "", tail or "") end
local function helpLine (left, right) ColourNote (CLR_HI, "", string.format (" %-10s", left), CLR_MSG, "", right) end
-- ===================================================================== -- Configuration -- ===================================================================== local COMBAT_STATE = 8 -- char.status "state": fighting
-- An attempt only stays live while the MUD is still answering us. Each fail -- line refreshes it; if nothing happens for this long we assume the fight is -- long over and stop retrying on a stale direction. local STALE_SECS = 60
local DIRS = { e = "east", w = "west", n = "north", s = "south", u = "up", d = "down", }
-- ===================================================================== -- State -- ===================================================================== local gEnabled = true -- reton / retoff / ret local gSilent = false -- retsilent: hide the per-retry "Retreat failed" line local gDir = nil -- direction word we are committed to, or nil local gLast = 0 -- os.time () of the last retreat we sent local gTries = 0 -- retreats sent this attempt local gVnum = nil -- last room.info vnum seen local gState = nil -- last char.status "state" seen (nil = not seen yet)
-- The attempt is over: moved, out of combat, cancelled, or plugin off. local function clearAttempt () gDir = nil gTries = 0 gLast = 0 end
local function attemptLive () return gDir ~= nil and (os.time () - gLast) <= STALE_SECS end
-- Out of combat the aliases are plain shortcuts: the retreat still goes to -- the MUD, but no attempt is armed - there is nothing to retry, and nothing -- to conflict with the next direction you pick in a real fight. gState is -- nil only before the first char.status of the session. local function inCombat () return gState == nil or gState == COMBAT_STATE end
local function sendRetreat () gTries = gTries + 1 gLast = os.time () Send ("retreat " .. gDir) end
-- ===================================================================== -- Alias callbacks -- =====================================================================
-- re / rw / rn / rs / ru / rd function RetreatDir (letter) local dir = DIRS[string.lower (letter or "")] if not dir then return end
-- Plugin off, or not fighting: send it, but don't arm a retry. if not gEnabled or not inCombat () then clearAttempt () Send ("retreat " .. dir) return end
-- Already committed to a different direction on a live attempt: cancel, -- and retry nothing until a direction is picked again. if attemptLive () and gDir ~= dir then clearAttempt () echo ("Conflicting Messages: Make Up Your Mind.") return end
if not attemptLive () then gTries = 0 end gDir = dir sendRetreat () end
function RetreatSetOn (on) gEnabled = on and true or false if not gEnabled then clearAttempt () end SetVariable ("enabled", gEnabled and "1" or "0") if gEnabled then echoHi ("Auto-retry is ", "ON", " - a failed retreat repeats the same direction.") else echoHi ("Auto-retry is ", "OFF", " - re/rw/rn/rs/ru/rd still send one retreat.") end end
function RetreatToggle () RetreatSetOn (not gEnabled) end
-- retsilent: hide/show the per-retry line. Status, conflict and help -- messages still print either way. function RetreatToggleSilent () gSilent = not gSilent SetVariable ("silent", gSilent and "1" or "0") if gSilent then echoHi ("Retry messages are ", "OFF", " - retrying quietly.") else echoHi ("Retry messages are ", "ON", " - each retry prints a line.") end end
function RetreatHelp () echo ("Retreat, and keep retreating, in one direction.") helpLine ("re rw rn", "retreat east / west / north") helpLine ("rs ru rd", "retreat south / up / down") helpLine ("reton", "turn auto-retry on") helpLine ("retoff", "turn auto-retry off") helpLine ("ret", "toggle auto-retry") helpLine ("retsilent", "toggle the per-retry message") helpLine ("ret help", "this screen") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " Every ", CLR_HI, "", "You FAIL to retreat!", CLR_MSG, "", " sends the same direction again, as many") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " times as it takes. Picking a different direction mid-attempt cancels it.") echoHi ("Currently ", gEnabled and "ON" or "OFF", (gDir and (", retreating " .. gDir) or "") .. (gSilent and ", retry messages off." or ".")) end
-- ===================================================================== -- Trigger callback: "You FAIL to retreat!" -- ===================================================================== function RetreatFailed () if not gEnabled then return end if not attemptLive () then return end sendRetreat () if not gSilent then echoHi ("Retreat failed - going ", gDir, " again (try " .. gTries .. ").") end end
-- ===================================================================== -- GMCP (telnet option 201) - end the attempt once it is resolved -- ===================================================================== function OnPluginTelnetSubnegotiation (theType, data) if theType ~= 201 then return end
local message = string.match (data, "^([%w%.%-_]+)") if not message then return end message = string.lower (message)
-- Moved rooms: the retreat worked (or something else moved us). if message == "room.info" then local vnum = string.match (data, '"num"%s*:%s*"?(%-?%d+)"?') if vnum and vnum ~= gVnum then gVnum = vnum if gDir then clearAttempt () end end return end
-- Out of combat: nothing left to retreat from. if message == "char.status" then local st = tonumber (string.match (data, '"state"%s*:%s*(%d+)') or "") if st then gState = st if st ~= COMBAT_STATE and gDir then clearAttempt () end end end end
-- ===================================================================== -- Housekeeping -- ===================================================================== function OnPluginInstall () gEnabled = GetVariable ("enabled") ~= "0" gSilent = GetVariable ("silent") == "1" clearAttempt () end
function OnPluginSaveState () SetVariable ("enabled", gEnabled and "1" or "0") SetVariable ("silent", gSilent and "1" or "0") end
